Income (pg 169):
Money from wages, pensions, subsidies, interest, dividends, or other sources available for
living and health care expenses

Signs/ Symptoms:
    Low/ no income                                   Able to buy only necessities
    Uninsured medical expenses                       Difficulty buying necessities
    Difficulty with money management                 Other



KBS rating considerations:
Mental Health (pg 199):
Development and use of mental/emotional abilities to adjust to life situations, interact
with others, and engage in activities.

Signs/ Symptoms:
    Sadness/ hopelessness/                        Somatic complaints/ fatigue
      decreased self-esteem                        Delusions
    Apprehension/ undefined fear                  Hallucinations/ illusions
    Loss of interest/ involvement in              Expresses suicidal/ homicidal
      activities/ self-care                         thoughts
    Narrowed to scattered attention/              Attempts suicide/ homicide
      focus                                        Self-mutilation
    Flat affect                                   Mood swings
    Irritable/ agitated/ aggressive               Flash-backs
    Purposeless/ compulsive activity              Other
    Difficulty managing stress
    Difficulty managing anger



KBS rating considerations:
Communication with Community Resources ( pg 181):
Interaction between the individual/ family/ community and social service
organizations, schools, and businesses in regard to services, information, and goods/
supplies.

Signs/ Symptoms:
  Unfamiliar with options/ procedures           Cultural barrier
    for obtaining services                       Educational barrier
  Difficulty understanding roles/               Transportation barrier
    regulations of service providers             Limited access to care/ services/
  Unable to communicate concerns to              goods
    provider                                     Unable to use/ has inadequate
  Dissatisfaction with services                  communication devices/ equipment
  Inadequate/ unavailable resources             Other
  Language barrier
 

KBS rating considerations:
Healthcare Supervision (pg 346):
Management of the health care treatment plan by health care providers


Signs/ Symptoms:
  Fails to obtain                            Inability to coordinate multiple
    routine/preventative health care           appointments/treatment plans
  Fails to seek care for symptoms            Inconsistent source of health care
    requiring evaluation/treatment            Inadequate source of health care
  Fails to return as requested to            Inadequate treatment plan
    health care provider                      Other


KBS rating considerations:
Interpersonal Relationships (pg. 190):
Association or bonds between the individual/family/community and others.

Signs/ Symptoms:
  Difficulty establishing/maintaining             Inappropriate
    relationships                                   suspicion/manipulation/control
  Minimal shared activities                       Physically/emotionally abusive to
  Incongruent                                      partner
    values/goals/expectations/schedules            Difficulty problem solving without
  Inadequate interpersonal                         conflict
    communication skills                           Other
  Prolonged, unrelieved tension

                     Omaha System Problem Modifiers Guide


Assessment            Actual                                                Potential

Definition            Client problem status characterized by the            Client status characterized by the
                      existence of one or more signs and symptoms           absence of signs and symptoms
                                                                            and the presence of patterns,
                                                                            practices, behaviors, or risk
                                                                            factors that may preclude optimal
                                                                            health
When to select        When signs/ symptoms are present                      When risk factors are present




When to put it        When the PHN will be addressing the issue in          When the PHN will be addressing
on the client’s       some way                                              the issue in some way
careplan


When not to put       When it's something the PHN won't be                  When it's something the PHN won't
it on the client’s    addressing. You should then select one of the         be addressing. You should then
careplan              options: low priority, self-care, other provider      select one of the options: low
                                                                            priority, self-care, other provider

Admission             Admission status rating must be 1,2,3, or 4. These    Admission status rating must be 5.
Status Rating         ratings mean signs/ symptoms are present              This rating means no signs/
                                                                            symptoms are present


Other                 Signs: Objective evidence about a client’s
                      problem.
                      Symptoms: Subjective evidence about a client’s
                      problem

Example:              Client is currently using drugs, alcohol or smoking   Has a history of substance use, is
Substance Use                                                               not currently using but is
                                                                            experiencing stressful events that
                                                                            put her at risk


        *Remember for all ratings, if you are trying to decide between 2 ratings, select the lower
        rating as a rule of thumb.

                                                                          Potential and you will not be
